approval_boundary: Candidate rows require named scientific and contract approval before registry promotion. Frozen rows are experimental repository contracts, not stable or cross-language capability claims.

classifications.functional: For value matrix V_ij over information and implementation regimes: realizable_EVPI=V_10-V_00; EVPIM=V_01-V_00; joint_EVP=V_11-V_00; interaction=V_11-V_10-V_01+V_00. EVSIM and IA-EVSI are declared specific-regime contrasts; EVEIm and EVSEIm remain terminology candidates.
assumptions: implementation and information actions and costs
classifications.compatibility: Existing implementation-voi and implementation-loss helpers are adjacent inputs or special cases, not matrix-decomposition parity.
classifications.evidence_strength: issue contract plus primary-definition candidates; no implementation or scientific review
classifications.search_limit: Issue-cited sources only; no systematic review claim.
classifications.no_positive_claim: An uptake multiplier, implementation-loss statistic or EVSI alone cannot establish this capability.

classifications.functional: For maximization, EEV is expected performance of the point-estimate solution with declared recourse, RP is the optimal nonanticipative stochastic value, WS is the scenario-wise wait-and-see value, VSS=RP-EEV and EVPI=WS-RP; signs reverse under minimization. EVIU requires an explicitly declared point-estimate-versus-uncertainty-representation contrast.
classifications.compatibility: PSA, EVPI, dynamic real options and solver adapters are adjacent comparators, not EVIU or VSS implementations.
classifications.evidence_strength: issue contract plus primary-definition candidates; no implementation or scientific review
classifications.search_limit: Issue-cited National Academies and Birge sources; no systematic review claim.
classifications.no_positive_claim: Uncertainty propagation, EVPI, a solver adapter or a chart cannot establish this capability.

classifications.functional: EUI is the expected-utility gain from the declared information structure; CEI is its certainty-equivalent gain; BPI and SPI are sure-transfer indifference roots. VoC is the clairvoyant-policy presentation. Monetary EVPI reduction is valid only under declared positive-affine utility and clairvoyant information.
assumptions: wealth or reference state and comparable units
declared information structure and cost location
classifications.compatibility: Stable monetary EVPI is unchanged; buying-price-voi maps to BPI; CVaR, preference weights and financial utility helpers remain distinct.
classifications.evidence_strength: Merged PR #712 with dedicated contract, phase review and exact-head hosted evidence; scientific and stable-promotion gates remain open.
classifications.search_limit: Dedicated track references; no stable-promotion approval.
classifications.no_positive_claim: Do not equate nonlinear-utility VoC with monetary EVPI or claim cross-problem cardinal comparability, stable maturity or polyglot parity.

classifications.functional: For event E, event VOI is P(E) max_a E[v|E] + P(not E) max_a E[v|not E] minus the current-information optimum. An imperfect signal uses its declared joint law. A declared information density must integrate to the corresponding information value within tolerance.
assumptions: declared event, threshold and concern direction
classifications.compatibility: Threshold plots, tail probabilities and conditional tables are adjacent only; parameter information, tail risk and forecast accuracy are distinct.
classifications.evidence_strength: issue contract plus primary-definition candidates; no implementation or scientific review
classifications.search_limit: Issue-cited INFORMS sources; no systematic review claim.
classifications.no_positive_claim: A conditional EVPI table, tail probability or plot cannot establish the event estimand or density assurance.

classifications.functional: At belief b and horizon H, value is the declared adaptive observation/control policy value minus the matched open-loop or no-sensing policy value, net of sensing cost. Myopic H=1 and nonmyopic H>1 policies use the declared transition, observation and belief-update models.
assumptions: sensing and control actions and costs
classifications.compatibility: Sequential, real-options, monitoring, knowledge-gradient, bandit and agent-information helpers are adjacent; scores and aliases are not parity.
classifications.evidence_strength: issue contract plus primary-definition candidates; no implementation or scientific review
classifications.search_limit: Issue-cited active-management and POMDP sources; no systematic review claim.
classifications.no_positive_claim: A one-step acquisition score, generic MDP/POMDP solver or sequential-EVSI label cannot establish this capability.

classifications.functional: Recipient or stakeholder value is expected utility under the information policy minus expected utility under the baseline allocation and declared cost. Social value applies the declared welfare aggregator to stakeholder outcomes. Values remain signed; aligned unconstrained Bayes-optimal settings provide only a conditional nonnegativity check.
assumptions: decision maker, recipient and controller roles
policy and epistemic constraints and incentives
classifications.compatibility: Strategic sharing, privacy, equity and federated helpers are adjacent; persuasion and rational inattention remain adjacent absent approval.
classifications.evidence_strength: issue contract plus primary-definition candidates; no implementation or rights review
classifications.search_limit: Issue-cited negative-information and team-sharing sources; no systematic review claim.
classifications.no_positive_claim: A game/privacy helper or expected-minus-baseline statistic that clips negatives cannot establish this capability.

classifications.functional: Static value compares subgroup-specific current-information policies with a population-average current-information policy. Dynamic value compares the corresponding perfect- or sample-information research values across the declared subgroup specification. Subgroup EVPI or EVSI is reported separately rather than conflated with either component.
classifications.compatibility: Existing heterogeneity, individualized-care, preference, distributional and uplift surfaces are adjacent special cases or inputs.
classifications.evidence_strength: issue contract plus primary-definition candidate; no implementation or scientific review
classifications.search_limit: Issue-cited static/dynamic framework; no systematic review claim.
classifications.no_positive_claim: Subgroup EVPI, CATE estimates or a heterogeneity plot cannot establish the decomposition.

classifications.functional: For sample outcome x, delta-EV_x is the posterior-policy system-value shift and VSI_x is the posterior-conditional decision gain over the baseline policy. Under declared classical assumptions E_x[VSI_x]=EVSI. sigma-VSI is the outcome dispersion and rVSI_delta=P(VSI_x<=delta).
assumptions: value threshold and utility or loss
prospective or retrospective scope and estimator calibration
classifications.compatibility: This may compose with risk-sensitive VOI, but risk in realized information value is distinct from system-outcome risk; EVSI intervals and CVaR helpers are adjacent.
classifications.evidence_strength: issue contract plus primary-definition candidate; no implementation or scientific review
classifications.search_limit: Issue-cited preprint and journal mapping; no systematic review claim.
classifications.no_positive_claim: An EVSI standard error, confidence interval or CVaR helper cannot establish the outcome-conditional distribution.

classifications.functional: EVPPI_var(S)=Var(g(theta))-E[Var(g(theta)|theta_S)] and EVSI_var(d)=Var(g(theta))-E_Y[Var(g(theta)|Y,d)]. Vector targets require declared covariance outputs and a separately reviewed scalar functional; vector execution is currently unsupported.
assumptions: declared scalar or vector target and units
prior, subset or design and likelihood
estimator, seed, tolerance and degeneracy policy
classifications.compatibility: Strictly separate from decision EVPPI/EVSI, Sobol sensitivity, posterior estimator variance and EVSI estimator standard error.
classifications.evidence_strength: Merged PR #676 with scalar Rust/Python execution and exact-head evidence; vector, scientific and stable-promotion gates remain open.
classifications.search_limit: Dedicated track analytical/discrete references; no vector or stable approval.
classifications.no_positive_claim: Scalar runtime does not establish vector execution, polyglot parity, stable maturity, release or issue closure.
